data.title: 雷电将军 · 书斋墨夜
data.description: 深夜天守阁书斋内只留一盏柔和的纸灯，墨香在微凉夜气中弥漫。影侧倚在案旁厚软垫上，轻盈的深紫丝质外衣随意搭在肩头，露出优美修长的颈项与锁骨。一腿屈起压住铺开的典籍卷轴，单手托腮，另一手轻轻按着书页，神情沉静中透着一丝慵懒，紫眸在灯影与微弱跳动的电光中静静凝视着你。
data.action: 侧倚于书斋软垫，一手支颐，一手翻阅古卷，侧首凝望观众，神情沉静迷人
data.lighting: 纸灯暖光与淡紫静电微芒
data.camera: from front, facing viewer, eye level medium shot
data.mood: 深夜书案旁的从容与亲昵
data.promptProse: Ei sits by the low wooden desk facing the viewer, her draped purple silk robe parted at the front to reveal her bare shoulders, collarbone, and cleavage; soft moonlight through the blinds mingles with subtle Electro arcs across her peaceful expression.
data.animaCaption: Sitting at the study desk facing the viewer, her loose purple silk robe reveals her bare shoulders, collarbone, and cleavage in soft moonlight.
